complexity.notes: The variable best_buy is dead code — it is updated but never used in the profit calculation (the inner loop uses prices[i] directly); its initialization to 100 would also be wrong given prices can be up to 10^4. A single-pass O(n) solution tracking the minimum price so far would be idiomatic; as written this will time out for n = 10^5.
complexity.summary: Brute-force approach: for each buy day i, scans all later days j and tracks the maximum price difference, returning the best profit found (or 0 if none).
